title: Casa Madalena | KEY.co
description_expanded: Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive. Perfectly positioned along the sugar-white sands of Miramar Beach, this breathtaking Gulf-front retreat offers panoramic water views, a private pool, and direct access to your own stretch of beach. Designed for unforgettable gatherings, the open-concept main house flows effortlessly from one stylish living space to the next, with wall-to-wall windows that flood the interiors with natural light and endless ocean vistas. A spacious kitchen with marble countertops and GE Profile appliances makes entertaining a joy, while the expansive deck invites sunset dinners and slow mornings with a view.
